'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Tom Frafjord DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Frafjord]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
